scope: Extend Xroga's existing connected-app discovery and workflow selectors with explicit Composio account selection and a dedicated Zurelay DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 planning route. This is a bounded implementation, not a claim of universal or live app execution.

keep: Canonical Composio HTTP transport with egress binding
Existing tenant authority, budget ledger, scheduler, workflow state and confirmation gates
extend: Enable explicit account selection for action sessions
Prefer relevant connected toolkits in public metadata searches
Route connected-app tool selection to the one specified Zurelay DeepSeek model

schemaImpact.rollout: No database migration. Deploy backend only after complete CI, authenticated isolated staging, live tool-response validation and release approval.
schemaImpact.rollback: Revert this backend commit and redeploy the prior Cloud Run revision; no schema or stored user data need deletion.

auth.description: Action sessions now require Composio multi-account mode and explicit selected account; old action sessions must be prepared again.

tenant.description: Existing tenant binding and account-owner checks remain; no cross-tenant capability is introduced.

approval.description: Existing consequential-action confirmation and authority permits remain mandatory.

credentials.description: Dedicated model route reads only the existing server-side ZURELAY_API_KEY; no key is sent to the client or logs.

egress.description: Connected-app planning messages use the pinned Zurelay HTTPS endpoint; public Composio search metadata still excludes private task text.

cost.description: Zurelay's published input/output prices are registered; existing DeepSeek quota pool and provider reservation ledger remain in force; no fallback model is permitted for this lane.

billing.description: No subscription or payment behavior changes.

tests.scope: Model pinning, workflow decomposition, account binding and metadata privacy
Transport isolation, cost reservation and account-bound execution

architecture.reason: No new scheduler, authority database or app execution plane. The dedicated model ID uses the existing reservation and usage ledger.

rollout: Hold production release until the official SDK/runtime choice is reviewed, live Zurelay tool calls and signed-in Gmail/GitHub/Canva staging journeys pass, and all required CI/security gates pass. Deploy a source-pinned preview before default traffic.
rollback: Revert the bounded backend changes and restore the previous Cloud Run revision; do not alter user connections or stored workflow records.
knownGaps: The official current @composio/core SDK requires Node >=22.22.3 while Xroga pins 22.21.x; the existing guarded Composio HTTP client remains in use pending compatible runtime/security review.
